BC-FJA BC-FIPS versions 2.1.0 through 2.1.2 are affected on Linux x86_64 systems using AVX or AVX-512f in GCM cipher modes. BC-FIPS 2.1.3 is the fixed release and is available from Maven Central; Strimzi Kafka FIPS variants currently ship 2.1.2 via the eclipse-temurin-fips runtime package, and adoption of the fixed release is pending.

Vulnerability affects BC-FJA BC-FIPS versions 2.1.0 through 2.1.2 on Linux X86_64 with AVX/AVX-512f. No fixed version is currently available in the payload or upstream advisories. The issue is associated with gcm128w and gcm512w program files. Monitoring for upstream patch release.

No fixed version is published by BouncyCastle upstream yet. The advisory states the affected range is >=2.1.0,<=2.1.2 with no fix available as of the scan date. The FIPS variant of datahub-frontend-react uses bc-fips 2.1.2 from the Eclipse Temurin FIPS base image. Tracking the BouncyCastle FIPS release stream for a remediation.

CVE-2026-8149 is a local availability issue in Bouncy Castle BC-FIPS 2.1.0-2.1.2 affecting specific CPU instruction sets (AVX, AVX-512f) on Linux x86_64. bc-fips 2.1.2 is bundled in the eclipse-temurin FIPS JRE as a transitive dependency required for FIPS 140-3 compliance (CMVP #4943). No upstream fix is available; the FIPS module certification requires bc-fips 2.1.0, and the JRE vendor has not released a patched version. The vulnerability requires local access and affects only the GCM cipher mode implementation. Piraeus Server FIPS variants inherit this dependency from the certified JRE and cannot independently upgrade bc-fips without breaking FIPS compliance. Tracking upstream eclipse-temurin for a certified update that resolves CVE-2026-8149 while maintaining CMVP #4943 certification.

CVE-2026-8149 affects Bouncy Castle BC-FJA BC-FIPS 2.1.0 through 2.1.2 on Linux X86_64 with AVX/AVX-512f. The vulnerability is associated with GCM cipher implementations (gcm128w, gcm512w). This CVE is under investigation pending upstream release of a patched version.

The vulnerability has local attack vector (CVSS AV:L) with availability-only impact (CVSS VA:L). Monitoring upstream for a patched release.

statements.status_notes: Nessie FIPS variants bundle Bouncy Castle bc-fips 2.1.2 (BCFIPS_VERSION via image/.bouncycastle.inc.yaml). No upstream fix is available: the GHSA advisory (GHSA-mx76-r943-rf8g) records first_patched_version as null and Maven Central currently publishes no release beyond 2.1.2. The flaw is in the AVX-widened GCM pipelines (gcm128w/gcm512w) on x86_64 hosts and impacts availability only (CVSS AV:L). Remediation requires upstream Bouncy Castle to ship a patched 2.x release. Nessie non-FIPS variants do not include bc-fips and are not affected.
